description: The deprecated attribute on unknown_capability() and the 'Always use this instead' doc on unknown_capability_with_detail are mutually reinforcing. A contributor reading either entry point gets the full picture. If someone suggests removing the #[deprecated] because 'the doc already says so', resist: the deprecated attribute gives a compiler warning at every call site, which the doc comment cannot do.
title: Deprecation + doc pairing on unknown_capability is well-structured
